title: Animals of the ocean
examples: Do all ocean animals breathe the same way?
What is the difference between a fish and a mammal?
What lives in the really deep parts of the ocean?

explain.say: Today we say we are learning about ocean animals. We will look at three groups. These groups are fish, mammals, and octopus.
Fish use gills to take oxygen from the water. They do not need to breathe air like us. A shark is a good example of a fish.
Mammals like dolphins and whales breathe air using lungs. They must come to the surface to breathe. A dolphin is a mammal.
Octopuses are very clever creatures with eight arms. They breathe using gills, just like fish. They do not use lungs to breathe air.
The deep sea is very dark and has high pressure. Many animals there are strange and unique. Some deep sea creatures glow to see.
When you see a dolphin jumping high out of the water, it is using its lungs to breathe air. This shows it is a mammal that needs to surface. It cannot breathe underwater like a fish.

faq.q: Do all ocean animals breathe the same way?
faq.a: No, they do not all breathe the same way. Some use gills, while others use lungs to breathe air.
asks: How do different sea creatures breathe?
Is it true that all sea life breathes water?

faq.q: Which animals breathe air, even if they live in the sea?
faq.a: Mammals like whales and dolphins breathe air using lungs. They must surface to take breaths.
asks: Do dolphins need to come up for air?
Are there sea animals that use lungs?

faq.q: What is the main difference between a fish and a mammal?
faq.a: The main difference is how they breathe. Fish use gills for water oxygen, and mammals use lungs for air.
asks: What do fish use to breathe?
Do mammals have gills or lungs?

faq.q: What is an octopus, and how does it breathe?
faq.a: An octopus is a very smart animal with eight arms. It breathes using gills, which take oxygen from the water.
asks: What is the octopus's breathing method?

faq.q: What kind of life exists in the deep sea?
faq.a: The deep sea is very dark and has high pressure. Many animals there have special ways to survive in the dark.
asks: Are there animals in the deep ocean?
What is life like deep down?

facts: Fish breathe oxygen from water using gills.
Marine mammals, like whales, breathe air using lungs.
Octopuses breathe using gills, similar to fish.
The deep sea has very little sunlight reaching it.

quiz.say: A dolphin is a mammal that breathes:
quiz.why: Dolphins are mammals, and mammals breathe air using lungs.

wrong.0: Gills are for breathing water oxygen, not air.
wrong.1: Water is what they live in, not what they breathe.
wrong.2: They use one system, not both at the same time.

quiz.say: Which animal group uses gills to get oxygen from water?
quiz.why: Fish are defined by their use of gills to extract oxygen from water.

wrong.0: Mammals use lungs to breathe air.
wrong.1: Octopuses also use gills, but fish is the primary group example.
wrong.2: Not all ocean animals breathe using gills.

quiz.say: If an animal lives in the deep sea, it might:
quiz.why: Some deep sea creatures have special light-producing abilities to survive the darkness.

wrong.0: Many deep sea animals are quiet to survive.
wrong.2: The deep sea has no sunlight reaching it.
wrong.3: The food sources there are varied, not just plants.
